intro: Designed for everyday ease, The Enterprise 1500 makes your work effortless. With smart storage, neat design, and a sturdy build, your workspace keeps up with your fast-paced day—not slow you down.

features.title: Stay focused with a clutter-free space
features.text: Messy cables can be a distraction. Thoughtfully placed wire slots keep your cords neatly tucked away, so you can stay organized and work without interruptions.

features.title: A little privacy goes a long way
features.text: Whether you’re in a shared office or your cabin, the particle board modesty panel offers the privacy you need while adding a touch of warmth to your workspace.

features.title: Storage that keeps everything within reach
features.text: From important files to everyday essentials, the built-in pedestal provides ample storage, keeping your workspace tidy and your essentials right where you need them.

features.title: One key for total peace of mind
features.text: No more fumbling with multiple locks—secure all three drawers with a single turn, keeping your important documents safe while you step away.

features.title: Effortless access, every time
features.text: Designed for everyday ease, the smooth plastic grips on the drawers make opening and closing effortless—because your desk should work for you, not against you.

care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
name: Enterprise Without Cpu Hanger Office Desk 1500 W
